schema:measurementTechnique.schema:termCode: LA-ICP-MS (193 nm excimer laser + ICP-MS; top-level technique)
schema:measurementTechnique.schema:name: LA-ICP-MS (193 nm excimer laser + ICP-MS; top-level technique)

schema:object: Martian meteorite (Tissint) silicates, oxides, and glass: olivine, low-Ca pyroxene, augite, maskelynite, Fe-Ti-Cr oxides, shock melt glass, fusion crust

bios:computationalTool.schema:name: AMS ver. 1.0 (Mutchler et al. 2008; Analysis Management System, stand-alone software)

ada:spotGeometryDefault: 24 and 32 µm diameter (commonly used for silicates and glass); 90 µm (some olivine analyses to evaluate low REE signal sampling)
ada:laserFluenceDefault: 7–10 J/m² (stated in paper; units as written; likely a typographic error for J/cm²)
ada:analysisSequenceDefault: NIST 610 glass standard analyzed before and after every session; unknowns in between
ada:backgroundCountTimeDefault: 50 s (background counted for 50 s before each LA-ICP-MS analysis)
ada:internalStandardApproach: Normalization to 100 wt% oxide total (for silicates and oxides)
ada:elementalFractionationCorrection: External calibration using NIST 610 glass standard analyzed before and after session; oxide-sum normalization corrects for ablation yield variation; no explicit downhole fractionation correction described
ada:signalIntegrationIntervalMethod: Time-lapse plots of each spot examined; only the plateau region used to quantify trace element abundances
ada:blankBackgroundCorrectionMethod: 50 s background measurement before each analysis; background subtracted (method not explicitly described beyond counting duration)
ada:calibrationStandardMeasurementFreque: NIST 610 glass standard analyzed before and after every session

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: 100% oxide total normalization applied per analysis for silicates and oxides; NIST 610 used for external calibration before and after session
